Package implementations

Class MyQueue

java.lang.Object
implementations.MyQueue
All Implemented Interfaces:
QueueADT
public class MyQueue extends Object implements QueueADT
A doubly linked list-backed implementation of the QueueADT interface, for use in CPRG 304 at SAIT.

This class delegates all storage to an internal MyDLL, treating index 0 as the front of the queue and the last index as the back. enqueue(String) appends to the back; dequeue() and peek() access the front. A queue follows a First-In, First-Out (FIFO) ordering policy: the first element enqueued is the first one returned.

Design Note – String-Specific Implementation:
This class is intentionally designed to store String elements only. A fully reusable, type-safe design would use Java generics (e.g., MyQueue<E>), allowing any object type to be stored in the queue. Generic programming is outside the scope of CPRG 304 and has therefore been omitted. All element fields, parameters, and return types are fixed as String throughout this class and its implementations.
